description: Schema for a WellKnownIndex registry entry: the frontmatter of content/registry/<slug>.md, or the same shape as a JSON submission.

auth_schemes.description: How an agent authenticates, as slugs.

cost.description: e.g. free, unknown, or a short pricing note.

methods_implemented.description: WellKnownIndex method slugs this site implements.

protocols.description: The site's machine endpoints. Exact callable endpoints go in url; URI templates in url_template; explanations in note. An endpoint that cannot be established uses status 'unconfirmed' with a note — never prose inside url.

type.description: Protocol type slug, e.g. ai-primer, staging-api, mcp-bridge, well-known.

version.description: The protocol's declared version, e.g. "1.3.0". Recommended: agents pin behavior to it; breaking changes bump the major number.

url.description: Exact callable endpoint: a clean absolute URL. No prose, no unexpanded placeholders.

url_template.description: URI template containing a {placeholder}, e.g. https://example.org/review?token={token}.

note.description: Explanation for agents: what is unconfirmed, where to look instead, caveats.

status.description: 'confirmed' (default) or 'unconfirmed'. Unconfirmed requires a note and forbids guessing a URL.

scopes.description: The permission vocabulary, if the site has one.

site_url.description: The site's home page, or null if it is not publicly reachable.

verified.description: Date of the last real verification check, YYYY-MM-DD. Never advanced by a rebuild — only by a new check.

verified_evidence.description: What the verification actually checked, one line per check: fetched endpoints, confirmed flows, known limitations.

title: WellKnownIndex registry entry
